I am farming a small rented plot here near Dar es Salaam, only about a quarter hectare, and the soils around here are sandy and tired. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer this season — the price is too high for a rented plot where I am not sure I will farm it again next year. I will put some manure I can gather, use seed I saved from last time, and do most of the work myself with my family. Labor like weeding I will handle on my own, maybe call a neighbor for a day or two if the weeds get bad.
